news.first_job_headline.text: The frame stayed. Everything inside left.
news.first_job_headline.note: P07 optional museum reading and curation.

news.first_job_p1.text: A new thief has a remarkably tidy method. The latest missing object: {art}.
news.first_job_p1.note: P07 optional museum reading and curation.

news.first_job_p2.text: A clean exit is not an answer to who should hold the work. For now, the city has a story and an empty space.
news.first_job_p2.note: P07 optional museum reading and curation.

news.famous_target_headline.text: Recognition is not a claim of ownership
news.famous_target_headline.note: P07 optional museum reading and curation.

news.famous_target_p1.text: Everyone recognizes {art}. That makes its disappearance louder, not its new custody easier to defend.
news.famous_target_p1.note: P07 optional museum reading and curation.

news.famous_target_p2.text: A famous image can bring attention to a collection. Attention should also bring questions about access and responsibility.
news.famous_target_p2.note: P07 optional museum reading and curation.

news.private_sale_headline.text: A price was agreed. Access was not.
news.private_sale_headline.note: P07 optional museum reading and curation.

news.private_sale_p1.text: {art} has moved to a private buyer. The transaction improves a thief’s finances; it does not open a public door.
news.private_sale_p1.note: P07 optional museum reading and curation.

news.private_sale_p2.text: The recovered records remain separate from the original. Evidence can survive a sale while access to the work narrows.
news.private_sale_p2.note: P07 optional museum reading and curation.

news.public_sale_headline.text: A new wall, and a public promise
news.public_sale_headline.note: P07 optional museum reading and curation.

news.public_sale_p1.text: Riverlight Salon confirms a purchase from Pixel’s collection: {art}. The public-facing buyer paid less than the private offer.
news.public_sale_p1.note: P07 optional museum reading and curation.

news.public_sale_p2.text: The salon welcomes the attention. Its promise of access still leaves the history of the object open to examination.
news.public_sale_p2.note: P07 optional museum reading and curation.

news.first_return_headline.note: P07 optional museum reading and curation.

news.first_return_p1.text: The Restoration Cooperative acknowledges the verified return of {art}. These samples are part of our working history.
news.first_return_p1.note: P07 optional museum reading and curation.

news.first_return_p2.text: There was no sale payment. Our letter records gratitude and a renewed relationship, not permission for every theft.
news.first_return_p2.note: P07 optional museum reading and curation.

news.first_loan_headline.text: A collection lends, and makes room
news.first_loan_headline.note: P07 optional museum reading and curation.

news.first_loan_p1.text: Riverlight Salon has accepted {art} on loan. For the loan period, the original leaves the Night Museum.
news.first_loan_p1.note: P07 optional museum reading and curation.

news.first_loan_p2.text: A photograph can remember the choice, but cannot fill the original’s place in a physical exhibition.
news.first_loan_p2.note: P07 optional museum reading and curation.

news.first_exhibition_headline.text: An arrangement begins to make an argument
news.first_exhibition_headline.note: P07 optional museum reading and curation.

news.first_exhibition_p1.text: Three originals sharing a theme have met on one floor of the Night Museum. {art} was among that first group.
news.first_exhibition_p1.note: P07 optional museum reading and curation.

news.first_exhibition_p2.text: The milestone belongs to the museum’s history. Sell or move an original and the present arrangement may tell a different story.
news.first_exhibition_p2.note: P07 optional museum reading and curation.

news.first_commission_headline.text: Glimmer office disputes a diverted delivery
news.first_commission_headline.note: P07 optional museum reading and curation.

news.first_commission_p1.text: The office objects to the redirection of a collection following the Moon Gate Mask job. It calls the delivery instructions binding.
news.first_commission_p1.note: P07 optional museum reading and curation.

news.first_commission_p2.text: The statement does not explain why Rocco and Sprocket’s device appeared on the same order. That omission remains on the record.
news.first_commission_p2.note: P07 optional museum reading and curation.

news.verified_fragment_headline.text: One verified fragment is a beginning
news.verified_fragment_headline.note: P07 optional museum reading and curation.

news.verified_fragment_p1.text: A record in added conservation material has been archived after the reconstruction of {art}. It is a later addition in this fictional case, not a message by the original artist.
news.verified_fragment_p1.note: P07 optional museum reading and curation.

news.verified_fragment_p2.text: The fragment can be checked even if the object changes hands. It does not by itself settle every ownership claim.
news.verified_fragment_p2.note: P07 optional museum reading and curation.
